tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background. Everything sits on this.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, file rows on hover. One step off bg.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only, not for controls.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs and checkboxes. Meets 3:1 against bg.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg or surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: file sizes, dates, hints. 4.5:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand colour: primary buttons, links, selection, focus ring.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected row or soft badge background; text on it is accent.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, synced. Text or icon on bg.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention. Text or icon on bg.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete, errors. Text or icon on bg.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px outline with 2px offset on every focusable element.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty states and page titles, once per screen.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, default gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margins, empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards that float over content. Prefer borders.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus and dialogs.
